subject: Contract acceleration & Q3 capacity snapshot
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Hassan <ops@luminoai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract acceleration & Q3 capacity snapshot

Hi Amira —

Thanks again for walking through usage last week. I pulled together a short snapshot of the Q2 token trajectory and a 90‑day projection attached (Q2-Lumino-usage.csv) plus a latency breakdown for the production endpoints (latency-report.pdf). High-level summary:

- Current monthly token runrate: ~1.1B tokens (30-day trailing).
- Q2 growth: ~28% month-over-month driven by higher sampling and batch inference for personalization flows.
- Peak tail latency for candidate generation endpoints is trending 95th pct at ~480ms (we recommend tuning batching windows for the long-tail ops).
- ROI: inference cost per active session has gone down ~12% after autoscaling and KV cache rollout, but unit cost still rises with higher token density.

Given your Q3 roadmap (multi-model experiments + expanded personalization), it looks like capacity needs will increase next quarter. To avoid overages and give LuminoAI predictable economics, we can:

1) Accelerate contract amendment now to add a +40% commit uplift for Q3 (with a one‑time onboarding discount of 10% on incremental commit for the first quarter).
2) Offer a burst credit pool (30M tokens/month) to absorb experimental spikes while we adjust batching and quantization settings.
3) Include an SLA addendum for p95 latency and a weekly operations sync for the first 60 days.

Next steps I propose:
- If this approach looks viable, Ben (cc'd) and I can draft a mutual action plan and an amended SOW for your procurement team.
- Hoping to schedule a 30‑min call early next week to align commercial terms and technical steps — are you available Mon/Tue morning PT?

Attaching the two reports for reference.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415‑555‑0132
attachments: Q2-Lumino-usage.csv (csv), latency-report.pdf (pdf)
From: Amira Hassan <ops@luminoai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <cfo@luminoai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract acceleration & Q3 capacity snapshot

Tessa —

Thanks for the quick summary and the files. Appreciate the proactive sizing. High level reaction from ops & finance: the projected +40% commit makes sense from a runway perspective, but Marco would like clarity on a couple of points before we move to an amendment:

- How will the incremental discount be applied (tiered vs flat across incremental tokens)?
- What guardrails are in place for accidental burst consumption from experiments? We prefer hard caps with overflow routing rather than open overages.

Also looping in Marco to confirm procurement cadence for amendments — he’s generally available Tue/Thu afternoons PT.

Can you put the proposed discount and the proposed hard cap language into the MAP draft so procurement can review?

Thanks,
Amira
VP of Operations | LuminoAI
ops@luminoai.com
attachments: (none)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Hassan <ops@luminoai.com>, Marco Ruiz <cfo@luminoai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract acceleration & Q3 capacity snapshot

Amira / Marco —

Thanks for the quick reply. Short answers inline and a proposed MAP attached (mutual-action-plan.docx).

- Discount structure: 10% off incremental tokens for the first quarter after amendment. That means base commit stays priced as-is; the uplifted portion (the +40% incremental commit) receives the 10% credit. We can make it tiered if you prefer (e.g., 10% first quarter, 7% second). I put the flat option in the MAP for clarity.

- Burst guardrails: we recommend a two-tier overflow policy: (a) hard cap on billable tokens routed to a cold pool (configurable ceiling, default 30M tokens/month), and (b) automated overflow routing to a lower-cost model variant if the hard cap is hit. Overflow routing will be non-billable until the hard cap is breached; beyond that, overage rate applies (we included a soft cap notification at 80%). Language and exact caps are in section 3 of the MAP.

Operational notes:
- We’ll run a 14-day pilot on the uplifted commit with an ops playbook that includes KV cache tuning and one week of tracing-enabled runs to validate latency improvements.
- Ben and Monica will own onboarding and the ops checklist; technical kickoff can be scheduled with your SREs.

Proposed times for a 30-min alignment: Tue 11:00–11:30 PT or Thu 13:00–13:30 PT. Let me know which works and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.docx (outlines discount, caps, SLA addendum, pilot plan)

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: mutual-action-plan.docx
